items.p: It flew for twenty years and then fell into the planet on purpose, so it wouldn't contaminate a moon that might hold life. Every part of it had to survive a decade before it mattered.
An engineer who solves everything with materials, improvisation, and a willingness to be wrong out loud.

items.h: Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?
items.p: The question I'd like my work to sit underneath.
